```yaml

id: vuln-tabby-1c077147
languages:
  - typescript
message: Potential security vulnerability in SSHSession.authHandler
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-48460
  cwe: CWE-295
pattern: 
  metavar: authHandler: (methodsLeft, partialSuccess, callback) => { this.zone.run(async () => { callback(await this.handleAuth(methodsLeft)) }) }
taint-mode:
  metavar: authHandler: (methodsLeft, partialSuccess, callback) => { this.zone.run(async () => { await hostVerifiedPromise; callback(await this.handleAuth(methodsLeft)) }) }
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerable behavior in the `authHandler` method of the `SSHSession` class. The `taint-mode` field is used to detect the patched behavior, which ensures that the `hostVerifiedPromise` is awaited before calling `handleAuth`.
